Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

ABOUT THE TEAM + ROLE

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Experimentation Platform team at Robinhood builds the systems and infrastructure that power our company-wide experimentation efforts. Our mission is to enable rapid, trustworthy, and statistically sound experimentation at scale, so teams can learn quickly and make confident decisions. We partner closely with engineering, product, and data teams across the company. The team's work has a direct impact on product velocity and business outcomes. Together, we're driving a culture of data-informed innovation across Robinhood.

As a Senior Data Scientist on the Experimentation Platform team, you'll play a key role in shaping the statistical foundations of our experimentation systems. You'll collaborate closely with engineering, product, and data partners to advance best practices in A/B testing, improve experiment velocity, and build capabilities that help Robinhood scale experimentation effectively. You'll also explore how AI-powered capabilities can automate workflows and strengthen decision-making, while serving as a trusted statistical partner to data science and product teams. This is a high-impact role with the opportunity to define how we learn and iterate across our products!

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Enhance the statistical methodologies underpinning the experimentation platform, including A/B testing and advanced techniques
  • Evaluate current experimentation practices across Robinhood and identify areas for improvement
  • Partner with engineering to build scalable tools and infrastructure for experimentation
  • Identify and drive opportunities to integrate AI-powered capabilities into the experimentation platform, automating workflows, accelerating experimentation velocity, and improving decision-making
  • Develop and champion experimentation best practices, enabling teams to design, analyze, and interpret experiments with statistical rigor
  • Serve as a statistical expert and trusted partner to data science and product teams, providing guidance on complex experimental designs and causal inference challenges
  • Shape the experimentation platform roadmap by identifying high-impact opportunities, prioritizing initiatives, and driving solutions from concept through implementation and adoption

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Master's or PhD in a quantitative field (e.g., statistics, economics, mathematics, engineering, natural sciences)
  • 3+ years of experience with A/B testing, causal inference, experimental design, and statistical analysis in a tech environment
  • Deep expertise in statistical methods such as multivariate testing, adaptive experimentation, Bayesian inference, and machine learning techniques
  • Proficiency in Python or R for data analysis and experimentation workflows
  • Experience partnering with engineering and product teams to translate statistical methodologies into production-ready tools and platform capabilities
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex statistical concepts and influence technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience building experimentation platforms or integrating AI-powered capabilities into data science workflows is a plus

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer operates globally with a diversified 3 GW energy portfolio, and deploys Bitcoin mining and HPC datacenters in the United States, Bhutan, Norway, Canada, Malaysia, and Ethiopia.

We are seeking

We are seeking an AI Datacenter Construction Manager to lead on-site delivery of Bitdeer’s AI data center builds. Reporting to the VP, Data Center Construction, you will be Bitdeer’s senior representative on site, accountable for safety, schedule, quality, and cost from mobilization through energization, commissioning, and turnover.

You will manage the general contractor and trade partners day to day, coordinate discipline leads, and keep the site moving to plan. The ideal candidate has run large data center or mission-critical sites from the owner’s or general contractor’s side.

Location: Candidates will work on site as needed and should be based in one of the following areas, primarily in Texas and Ohio: Austin, TX; Rockdale, TX; Abilene, TX; Houston, TX; Dallas, TX; Massillon, OH; Clarington, OH; Columbus, OH; Akron, OH; or Pittsburgh, PA.

Site Leadership

  • Owner’s Representative: Act as Bitdeer’s on-site lead and single point of accountability for the build.
  • Contractor Management: Direct the general contractor and trade partners on safety, quality, productivity, and schedule.
  • Daily Coordination: Run site coordination meetings, look-ahead planning, and site logistics.

Schedule & Cost

  • Schedule Delivery: Drive the site schedule and short-interval plans, and flag and recover critical-path slippage.
  • Cost Oversight: Review change requests, quantities, and pay applications with cost and procurement.
  • Progress Reporting: Report progress, risks, and issues to the VP, Data Center Construction and the TPM.

Safety & Quality

  • Site Safety: Enforce site safety plans with the EHS Manager and lead by example in the field.
  • Quality Control: Verify work against drawings and specifications with the QA/QC Manager.
  • Issue Resolution: Resolve RFIs and field issues quickly with design and engineering.

Interfaces & Turnover

  • Discipline Coordination: Coordinate civil, electrical/HV, mechanical, fiber, and ELV scopes on site.
  • Authorities & Utilities: Work with local authorities, inspectors, and utilities on permits, inspections, and site access.
  • Turnover: Support commissioning and deliver punch-list closure, as-builts, and turnover.

  • Experience: 10+ years in construction management, including 5+ years leading data center or mission-critical sites.
  • Project Scale: Experience delivering large, fast-track builds with multiple concurrent trades.
  • Technical Breadth: Working knowledge of civil, structural, MEP, and commissioning on data center projects.

Hut 8 brings exceptional people together to solve the world’s most consequential problems at the intersection of energy and technology. Today, that means building infrastructure for AI at a pace and scale without precedent. Tomorrow, it could mean powering a new era of innovation through robotics, advanced manufacturing, or an industry that does not yet exist. Whatever the technology demands, our ambition holds: to build the defining physical infrastructure company of our generation.

We look for thinkers and builders with the rigor, humility, and ownership to solve problems at this scale. They start from zero and choose truth over tradition. They back the best idea, whatever its source. They bet on themselves and embrace the hard truths that force them to grow. Scope grows with impact. Responsibility grows with trust. And the people who step up help shape what comes next. We're building an organization around ownership, not hierarchy, where your influence is defined by what you take on, not what's written on your email signature.

The infrastructure is ambitious. The people behind it should be too.

At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We’re looking for three engineers to join each cohort of the Augustus Engineering Fellowship. You’ll spend 3–6 months in Berlin working on agentic projects with the team building our bank - the infrastructure connecting economies to the Western financial system.
